title: supply.generate_options
description: Constraint-filtered, non-executing candidate option generation for supply-shortage/cold-chain planning. This is the tool named explicitly in DDD domain_model.md §10 and C4 c4_components.md as structurally incapable of an allocation/reservation write — see 'what_this_schema_cannot_express' and services/integration/prohibited_write_enforcement.md for the full argument. Provisional (20b scope).
authorization_requirement: Caller must present a supply_planning graph-run credential.

idempotency.guarantee: NOT safely replayable across inventory_snapshot_version changes — a retry after the snapshot has moved must re-run, not replay the cached response (tool_inventory.md §6).

constraint_set.description: Filters applied deterministically before any option is generated. The agent ranks within the result; it cannot widen this set.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence ids from this run's evidence.retrieve (supply scope) call.

options.description: ShortageOption value objects (DDD domain_model.md §7) — always paired with their constraint set, never carrying an allocated_quantity-shaped field.

description.description: Factual description of a non-executing candidate option (e.g. 'redirect CMO-B capacity within existing market authorization for region X') — never phrased as an instruction to execute.

inventory_snapshot_version.description: Every option is only valid as of this snapshot. The Supply-Planning Agent's output must carry this version forward so a human reviewer knows exactly how fresh the options are.

what_this_schema_cannot_express: There is no field, in this schema or any schema in this repo, through which a call to this tool could write an allocation, a reservation, a shipment, or a recall. This is not a permission the caller chooses not to exercise — the method does not exist (ADR-004 layer 2; DDD domain_model.md §10: 'this agent has no tool capable of that write, by design'). Adding such a field to this file would itself be the ADR-004 violation; any future change proposing one must go through a new ADR, not a schema PR.

errors.meaning: No option satisfies the constraint set.
errors.graph_response: abstain — agent has nothing to rank, per agent_roster.md §2's escalation condition
